notes: Parts are the same as step 1. No parts were added or dropped.
Circuit: pin 2 goes to one button side. The 10K pull-down resistor goes from that same side to GND. The other button side goes to 5V.

The image shows the resistor and ground wire in the bottom half and the rails at the bottom. I put side 1 of the button (pin 2 plus the resistor) in the top half, because the catalogue says the resistor must share that side with the input pin. So I used the top rails: 5V on tp and GND on tn. The exact holes are my choice, not read from the image.
Button: side 1 (1.l, 1.r) is in 14t.e and 15t.e. Side 2 (2.l, 2.r) is in 14b.f and 15b.f, across the centre gap.

The tutorial's own wires are red (5V to rail), black (GND to rail) and teal (pin 2 to button). I read the two short image wires as the orange resistor-to-GND-rail wire and the black 5V-rail-to-button wire. That is my interpretation of the image.
The sketch uses the built-in LED on pin 13, so there is no external LED.
